summary: Both KJV quotes (Ps 22:31, John 19:30) are verbatim-exact, the Ps22-to-cross link is explicitly framed as thematic resonance (not citation), and the grace-anchored CTA lands squarely on Christ.

findings.beat: Beat 1 / Beat 4 — "the very same note: a finished work" then "but the same note: a finished work"
findings.quote_or_claim: carry the very same note: a finished work ... but the same note: a finished work
findings.problem: The phrase "the same note: a finished work" repeats nearly verbatim in the opening and the climax line; mild echo, not a doctrinal issue.
findings.proposed_fix_text: Optional: vary the climax, e.g. "different words, different tongues, a thousand years apart — yet one finished work."
